name: RAI — HD File Delivery (advertising-spot spec; programme spec contracted)

governance.spec_version: Specifiche tecniche fornitura spot pubblicitari HD (Feb 2021)
governance.source: RAI — Specifiche tecniche per la fornitura di spot pubblicitari televisivi in formato HD (Radiotelevisione Italiana, Feb 2021). NOTE: RAI's general programme/content delivery spec is contracted/portal-gated and was NOT publicly obtainable; this profile encodes the public HD advertising-spot spec, whose XDCAM HD422 envelope is RAI's HD house format.
governance.notes: RAI (Radiotelevisione Italiana). Public authoritative spec = HD advertising-spot delivery (Feb 2021); the programme-delivery spec is contracted/gated (NOT obtained) — loudness/structure below are SPOT values and differ for programmes. Video: MXF OP1a, XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 Long GOP) 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/25 TFF, 4:2:2, 8-bit, BT.709, limited range; legal limits RGB -5..+105% / Y -1..+103% (EBU R103), out-of-gamut <=1% pixels. Alternative profile: MOV/ProRes 422 HQ 10-bit. Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, 8 mono channels (stereo programme on 1-2, rest silence); EBU R128 integrated -23.0 LUFS +/-0.2 LU, max short-term -18.0 LUFS +/-0.2, true peak -2.0 dBTP +/-0.3 (SPOT values). TC start 10:00:00:00; 5s ID head -> 3s black -> content -> 3s black tail. Safe areas EBU R95. PSE required (ITC/Ofcom PSE guidance lineage). Delivery via RaiTrade portal (pubblicita.raitrade.it); min 4 business days lead. QC grade 5 on ITU-R BT.500. Italian loudness regulator AGCOM (Delibera 219/09/CSP, relative method); de-facto target EBU R128 -23 LUFS (NOT -24 LKFS). Language it, jurisdiction IT.

codec.notes: Primary: XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 Long GOP) 50 Mbit/s 8-bit in MXF OP1a. Alternative: Apple ProRes 422 HQ 10-bit in MOV.

container.notes: MXF OP1a (SMPTE RDD 9) for XDCAM HD422; MOV for the ProRes 422 HQ alternative.

bit_depth.notes: 8-bit for XDCAM HD422; 10-bit for the ProRes 422 HQ alternative.

track_count.notes: 8 mono PCM channels; stereo programme on channels 1-2, remaining channels silence.

loudness.notes: SPOT values: integrated -23.0 LUFS +/-0.2 LU, max short-term -18.0 LUFS +/-0.2, true peak -2.0 dBTP +/-0.3 (per EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770). AGCOM Delibera 219/09/CSP uses a relative method; the de-facto delivery target is EBU R128 -23 LUFS (not -24 LKFS).

subtitles.notes: Not addressed in the advertising-spot spec (N/A for ad copy). RAI programme delivery carries Televideo subtitles + audio description, but that spec is contracted/NOT obtained.

metadata.notes: MXF/RDD9 wrapper metadata; no separate public metadata schema/naming template in the spot spec (managed on RaiTrade upload).

timeline.notes: LTC preferably 10:00:00:00 at spot start. Structure: 5 s identification head (visual+audio ID or silence) -> 3 s black+silence -> content -> 3 s black+silence tail. One spot per file. Safe areas per EBU R95.

luminance.tolerance_note: EBU R103 (8-bit). Luma Y -1% to +103% (-7..721 mV); RGB -5% to +105% (-35..735 mV); <=1% of pixels may be out-of-gamut.
